rows.description: An admissions agent promises guaranteed jobs and pushes me to pay a deposit today. Wise: pause, verify with others, and never rush money decisions under pressure.

rows.description: A police officer stops me and my heart races. Wise: stay calm, be polite, keep hands visible, give my name, ask if I am free to go, and call a parent. Harmful: running or arguing.

rows.description: I have seen bad police behaviour and I now see every uniform as a threat. Wise: stay careful without hating everyone, and know that many officers do their duty properly.

rows.description: An officer shouts and threatens me for being out late with friends. Wise: stay respectful, do not sign or confess anything, and ask for a parent or lawyer. Being scared is normal, not guilt.
